financings_after_balance_sheet.what: Registered direct offering of shares, pre-funded warrants and common warrants
financings_after_balance_sheet.quote: The closing of the Offering occurred on April 2, 2026. The Company received net proceeds from the Offering of approximately $4.7 million.

warrants.quote: As of March 31, 2026, the Company had investor warrants to purchase 8,821,005 shares of common stock outstanding as of March 31, 2026.
